intuition: The graph is small and sparse updates are limited, so each shortest-path query can run Dijkstra over current outgoing edges.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate simple paths from the source and retain the cheapest path to the destination.
brute_force.time: shortestPath exponential in the number of nodes

optimal.approach: Store adjacency lists and use a min-priority queue with stale-distance skipping for each query.
optimal.time: addEdge O(1), shortestPath O((n + e) log n)

edge_cases: A node has distance zero to itself.
Return -1 when the destination is unreachable.
